$schema_note: Codex CLI hook event wiring for codex-research-bootstrap. Paths use ${CODEX_HOME:-${HOME}/.codex} as the bootstrap-install target. tools/install.py copies hooks/*.py into ${CODEX_HOME}/hooks/ at install time; this file is then merged into ${CODEX_HOME}/hooks.json (or kept project-scope at .codex/hooks.json when the project is trusted). Per https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks: events are SessionStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, Stop. There is no SessionEnd; the Stop-aggregation pattern (see AGENTS.md 'Stop-event audit-trail aggregation') substitutes.
$reference: .codex/config.toml (companion TOML); AGENTS.md sections 'Stop-event audit-trail aggregation' and 'ReproLog'.
$hooks_in_repo: hooks/session_start_provenance.py - SessionStart - provenance emission + closed-session aggregation
hooks/stop_audit_aggregator.py    - Stop         - append one per-turn JSON record under logs/
hooks/pre_bash_safety.py          - PreToolUse:Bash - block irreversible shell ops not caught by config.toml deny list
hooks/pre_write_phi_guard.py      - PreToolUse:Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit - flag PHI patterns in epi cwds
hooks/post_write_notebook_clean.py - PostToolUse:Write|Edit|NotebookEdit - run nbstripout on changed notebooks
